_comment: Placeholder for first-party OAuth client credentials. The release pipeline overlays this file with real Client ID + Secret values pulled from the FERAL-AI operator vault. Empty client_id values mean 'fall through to operator-supplied credentials' — see oauth_manager.py:_load_first_party_clients. Adding a real client_id here turns the provider into 'ready' for a fresh user out of the box; leaving it empty keeps the provider in 'provider_setup_required' mode with a doc link.
